snippet.title: 『KESU-JI』Trailer (English)
snippet.description:
*The game footage shows the Japanese language setting. This title supports English and Simplified Chinese.

Enjoy six different modes built around the core mechanic of merging!
https://www.otwo.jp/peakvox/en/kesu-ji/

Steam Scheduled for Release in Friday, August 26, 2026
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4607780

Nintendo Switch Scheduled for Release in autumn 2026

From puzzle to action and shooting, this exhilarating merge game offers a wide variety of merge-based gameplay!

A satisfying merge experience in a chill world!
Enjoy smooth controls and relaxed gameplay across 6 distinct modes, 
accompanied by charmingly chill graphics and sound!
Find your favorite mode and compete on online leaderboards with players around the world.

Earn rewards with your Total Score!
An online leaderboard tracking your cumulative total score across all games is also included!
Earn rewards based on your total score.
